name: ss
description: Ship Shape (ss): technical skills for building software, invoked as /ss:<skill>. /ss:go routes a request to a playbook (investigate, bug-fix, review, ui-critique, ship, edge-cases, babysit, review-setup, correct, learn) and sizes it to risk with a lightweight, standard or intensive route. The flow is shape → build → ship (/ss:shape settles the acceptance criteria, the build is the work itself, /ss:ship lands the branch), with project facts kept as approved lines in the repo's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md by /ss:record-fact, and /ss:investigate, /ss:edge-cases, /ss:babysit, /ss:review (its judge is the ss-review-judge agent on Sonnet), /ss:ui-critique (a screen judged on real screenshots by the ss-design-critic agent with an accessibility check each round, and fixed until the critic is pleased), /ss:review-setup, /ss:caretake, /ss:takeover, /ss:research, /ss:write-readme, /ss:orchestrate (one front per Desktop session, its memory a private Claude Docs doc or a local folder under ~/.ss/fronts), /ss:assistant (your assistant that helps you manage all your sessions) and /ss:correct (which /ss:go offers when the same correction lands twice) alongside, and situational skills an agent loads when their trigger in references/triggers.md fires. Any ss session merges a PR when the person says so in its chat, under the repository's rules.
